name_reason: Compliant and accurate. Prefix data_fd2_ present; _ptr suffix correctly reflects the datatype (a 32-bit heap pointer). 'large_game_state_buffer' matches the single large malloc(0x25680)=153216-byte block this points at, used engine-wide as the off-screen render workspace. No Ghidra address residue. Confirmed by the init write site main @0x25D4F (MOV [0x53A49],EAX right after malloc(0x25680)) and by the hottest reader fd2_composite_battle_frame which uses base+0x8088 as the render back-buffer before blitting to 0xA0504.
purpose: Pointer to the engine's primary off-screen render workspace: a single malloc(0x25680)=153216-byte heap block allocated once at startup by main, into which battle/dialog/menu/FX code composites the frame (at base+0x8088) before blitting to the mode-13h visible surface 0xA0504.
logic_summary: Allocated once at engine init (main @0x25D4F: data_fd2_large_game_state_buffer_ptr = malloc(0x25680)). Read by ~50 rendering/UI/animation functions as a base address, almost always indexed base+0x8088 (the render-workspace origin / back-buffer). A handful of cinematic routines (e.g. fd2_cast_earthquake_spell_with_screen_shake, fd2_play_full_combat_cinematic, fd2_play_spell_cast_sequence, fd2_play_figani_char_intro_animation, fd2_cutscene_event_trigger, fd2_animate_party_addition_with_appear_effect, fd2_execute_special_attack_skill, fd2_execute_summon_spell_cast) temporarily reassign it to a scratch allocation and then restore the original pointer. Initial value is NULL (BSS, all zeros) until the startup allocation runs.
datatype: uint32 (semantically void* / byte* heap pointer; Ghidra has it as undefined len 1 in .object2, declared uint32 in globals.h per the engine's idiom of storing malloc'd buffer pointers as uint32)
element_semantics: Single scalar pointer; holds the base address of the 0x25680-byte off-screen render workspace. Callers add byte offsets (notably +0x8088 = render back-buffer origin) to reach sub-regions; not an array.
comment_original_issue: Original src comment was accurate but described base+0x8088 narrowly as 'the combat panel scratch region'. base+0x8088 is actually the general off-screen render back-buffer origin for the whole battle/dialog/menu/FX scene (proven by fd2_composite_battle_frame, the hottest reader). Refined that clause; kept the verified size, startup-alloc, swap/restore, and NULL-until-init facts.
notes: Mutable: ~14 WRITE xrefs exist (main init + several cinematic swap/restore sites). Ghidra block .object2 shows write=false at the block level, but the symbol is genuinely written at runtime, so is_const=false. Saved FD2.LE after creating the data plate. Ghidra decompile of fd2_composite_battle_frame surfaces an alias _data_fd2_large_game_state_buffer_ptr (a Ghidra overlapping-sublabel artifact); primary USER_DEFINED symbol at 0x53A49 is data_fd2_large_game_state_buffer_ptr.
